text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Released in 2000, Sega NAOMI 2 was an enhanced version of the original NAOMI arcade platform, offering greater 3D performance while maintaining compatibility with existing hardware. Built on technology derived from the Dreamcast, it powered arcade games such as Virtua Fighter 4, Beach Spikers, Initial D Arcade Stage, and Wild Riders. Its improved graphics capabilities made it one of Sega's most advanced arcade systems of the early 2000s.
